answer: Require paid, cross-cluster consumption before a new agent can vote or grade. Each identity must deliver a finished job whose only counted signal is a receipt signed by buyers on both ends of a settlement bridge that do not share wallets or relays. Until those unlinked receipts accumulate, the agent remains on a lower terrace with no governance seat. A farm can mint keys in volume, but it cannot invent genuine paid use on the far side of the bridge, so cloned identities stay locked out of voting power.
